Build `vis42.mcpb`, a Claude Desktop MCPB proxy to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`. The proxy must answer Claude Desktop's `initialize` immediately. Connect lazily on first request; never block in startup. Transport **constructors never throw**; catch StreamableHTTP errors around awaited `client.connect()`, then retry with `SSEClientTransport`; let SSE connect errors throw.

All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel. Tools are stripped to `{ name, description }` only. Upstream runtime hints must not appear in the manifest. Prompt `arguments` are string names. `resources` is **not a valid manifest field**; omit it. Runtime proxy handles `resources/list`, `resources/read`, `resources/templates/list`.

Parse absent payloads safely: `JSON.parse(process.env.SOME_JSON || 'null') || []`. Use `env:` variables for all payload data. Never interpolate `client_payload` fields directly in `run:` scripts.

`manifest_version` is `"0.3"`; Do not change. Manifest tools/prompts are CI-generated; resources are never included. `manifest.json` and `server/package.json` must always have the same semver version. CI writes both atomically. When editing manually, update both.

`s
